name: denotate
description: Denotate .den editor: checking, navigation and origins

denotate.checkingWithinW.description: Opt in to checking within selected assumptions. Can reduce large conditions but increase storage for independent inputs. Changes recheck programs; admission is unaffected.

denotate.timeoutMs.description: Cooperative timeout in milliseconds per checker operation/query, not per program. Zero allows no time. Changes recheck every program in this window.

denotate.limits.description: Resource ceilings per checker operation/query, shared by every program in this window. Omitted values use checker defaults; zero allows no use. Changes recheck programs.

maxStructuralSplitDepth.description: Optional structural split depth allowance per component; exhausting it falls back to ordinary admission.

maxStructuralSplitLeaves.description: Optional structural split leaves allowance per component; exhausting it falls back to ordinary admission.

maxStructuralSplitScoringWork.description: Candidate scoring work per structural split node (default 1000000). Checked between complete scores; one score can exceed it. Keeps the best improving choice so far. Zero disables scoring.

maxStructuralSplitWork.description: Optional structural split work allowance per component; exhausting it falls back to ordinary admission.

maxAtoms.description: Ground atoms, including input-domain provider facts and intermediate atoms.

maxBddTasks.description: BDD operation tasks; available work/storage may impose a tighter effective ceiling.

maxConditionNodes.description: Conservatively counted retained BDD condition nodes, not heap bytes.

denotate.showLibraryRewrites.description: Show rewrite warnings for library rules in consuming programs. The library's own warnings, other diagnostics and full status summaries remain available.

scripts.build: npm run generate && cargo +1.93.0 build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --locked -p denotate-lsp --release && node build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:setup && npm run test:generation && npm run test:progress && npm run generate && cargo +1.93.0 test --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --locked -p denotate-lsp
